firstPlayerRule: Choose a starting player by any method and give them the governor placard. The governor chooses the first role.
clarifications: The governor performs the chosen role action first, followed clockwise by the other players. The next player clockwise then chooses a role.
At the end of the round, pass the governor placard left. With two players, the governor chooses a second role after the opponent.
internalEvidence: Official Rio Grande hosted original manual. Printed/PDF2 visually verified any-method selection, first role/action, clockwise sequence and next-round governor rotation.
